title: Check a builder or tradesperson licence
summary: Check if a building contractor or tradesperson has a valid licence before they begin work on your property.
intro:
If you're hiring a building contractor or tradesperson check online to find out if they have a valid contractor licence before they start the work. A licence is required for people to do residential building work, wiring, plumbing, draining, gasfitting, air conditioning or refrigeration work (except plug-in appliances).

To check a digital licence or certificate follow the instructions to Check a digital trade licence or credential in the Service NSW app.
who_can_apply: Hiring a building contractor or tradesperson for work on a property.
what_you_need: Location (suburb, postcode or local government area)

faqs.q: What types of work require a licence?
faqs.a: A licence is required for people to do residential building work, wiring, plumbing, draining, gasfitting, air conditioning or refrigeration work (except plug-in appliances).

faqs.q: How can I check a digital licence or certificate?
faqs.a: Follow the instructions provided to Check a digital trade licence or credential in the Service NSW app.

faqs.q: What information do I need to start the search?
faqs.a: You need any of the following to start your search: licensee name, licence number, licence type, Australian Business Number (ABN), Australian Company Number (ACN), or location (suburb, postcode or local government area).
